Q0668

“If we are to be faithful to our calling, we have to…” — Leopoldo Zea (Q0668)

An English quotation associated with Philosophy as Commitment (1952 [2017: 137]); SEP “Mexican Existentialism”, organized here under philosophy.

Quotes / Leopoldo Zea / Q0668

English

If we are to be faithful to our calling, we have to affirm that our situation is not that of Jean-Paul Sartre. Our situation is not that of the European bourgeoisie.
Thinker Leopoldo Zea
School Philosophy of History
Source Philosophy as Commitment (1952 [2017: 137]); SEP “Mexican Existentialism”
Theme Philosophy
Another quotation More from this thinker

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with Philosophy as Commitment (1952 [2017: 137]); SEP “Mexican Existentialism”, within the Philosophy of History tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of philosophy, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Leopoldo Zea's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
